stanceMinQuote.text: Salesforce stands with the Black community against racism, violence, and hate — and for justice and Equality for All. Our Racial Equality and Justice Taskforce is taking action in four areas: people, philanthropy, purchasing, and policy.
stanceMinQuote.heading: Taking Action with Racial Equality and Justice

stanceMaxQuote.text: We are more powerful when we work together. So we are on a journey to create a more inclusive and diverse workplace, and a more equal world. We have a great opportunity to ensure every human being benefits from products, experiences, and policies that foster equality.
stanceMaxQuote.heading: Equality for all.

stanceMinQuote.text: Trust is our #1 value. We build trust with stakeholders by leading with ethics and through the integrity of our technology. We are dedicated to transparency, deep listening, and delivering on our commitments.
stanceMinQuote.heading: In trust we trust.

stanceMaxQuote.text: Our aspiration is to create a workplace that looks like society. Transparency and accountability are key to advancing representation, so we've set these goals for 2030 , and we continually review our progress.
stanceMaxQuote.heading: Our 2030 goals.
